note: Copied, not regenerated. Every record carries the section 7.2 provenance pair: `producer`, the environment that produced or verified the bytes, and `generated_by`, the module or generator that makes them. The versions of debug_state.bin, core_eval.bin, train_parity.bin and generate_parity.bin come from one verification run in the reference virtual environment (python 3.10.21, torch 2.7.1+cu118, numpy 2.2.6, reference checkout HEAD 010ecf81915f3a368f5138857945d82dc9a5614b). That run reproduced each of those four files byte for byte, but the bytes themselves were copied from tests/data, so every record says so: producer.source names the run and regenerated is false, because the recorded environment is the verification run, not the historical producer. train_parity.bin additionally needs --nonzero-projections, an option the NANOORC1 container does not record. Two records are unverified and say why in producer.source: rl_parity.bin, because the current rl generator writes 67 records and 107998 bytes and no config/seed or config/prompt_len record while the committed file has 69 records and 108062 bytes. A generator revision that writes both config records, or a Model owner's answer, settles rl_parity.bin. The numeric fixture is verified: tools/dump_fixtures.py numerics reproduced its sha256 byte for byte on 2026-11-04. docs/host-portability.md cites the leaderboard entry a825e63; the commit recorded here is the checkout HEAD the verification run imported, not a substitute for that entry. The tools node --model selector becomes the generating authority after this release and must reproduce these bytes exactly. tests/data was not moved, rewritten, or deleted.
